actor_economy_pause.reason: no outcome of this study authorizes actors, wallets, health, needs, death, prices, transfers, markets or learning; a separate authorization gate is required

aggregate_quote_diagnostics.expected_sign: naive sum >= group quote on the credit side (foundation Prop 10.2); a violation falsifies the recorded convexity argument (F9)
aggregate_quote_diagnostics.group_quote: for every arm-A tick, record the exact aggregate local quote Delta e_group(q_vec) = V_loc(z) - V_loc(z + dt * sum_e S_e q_e_acc) - sum_e C_e(q_e_acc) over the source and its destinations, AND the naive sum of independently frozen per-edge quotes; their difference is the measured double-count
aggregate_quote_diagnostics.no_settlement: these are recorded functionals of frozen tick data; nothing is settled, credited or attributed; O3 remains open

arms.A_full_multi_edge_p1c: capability-SUPERSET benchmark, not the primary comparator: all locally generated outgoing requests accepted and proportionally scaled by the aggregate source budget (released p1c_step on the full world); bounded service; no EBU input; carries no EBU
arms.B_restricted_matched_non_ebu: PRIMARY comparator: one outgoing action per source per micro-step; the identical menu, quantity cap, request shaping, conflict rule and timestep as D; selection by the released loss-aware force f_e (largest f, tie by larger q_acc, then lower edge index); no EBU, no global service score, no rollout
arms.C_restricted_observational_quote: byte-identical physics to B (same selection); the executed action is quoted and settled observationally; the full candidate-menu schedules are recorded as diagnostics; quotes CANNOT affect action
arms.D_restricted_exact_total_quote_greedy: the actor under test: same menu/caps/timestep as B/C; selects per the registered heuristic; rests when no strictly positive exact quote exists; never ranks per unit
arms.E_aggregate_source_group_quote: NOT REGISTERED FOR EXECUTION (O3 open): no settling aggregate arm exists in this study; see aggregate_quote_diagnostics
arms.S_restricted_local_service_priority: REGISTERED strictly-local service comparator: same menu; score = eta_e * q_acc * 1[declared demand rate of destination > 0], ties by lower edge index then lower quantity-menu index (volume maximizer toward a demanding destination); reads ONLY the menu and the adjacent destination's declared demand rate; justification: separates quote-specific service loss (D vs S) from restriction-generic loss shared by B; declared limitation: ignores destination stock buffers
arms.forbidden_comparison: using unmatched arm A as the alignment comparator; labelling capability-caused service reduction as quote misalignment

bounded_service_semantics.domain: non-negative states; no clipping that creates phantom stock
bounded_service_semantics.reserve_diagnostic_tolerance: Gate 1D-A corrected scale-aware rule: materially_below_reserve(x, R_eff) iff x < R_eff - 1e-9 * (1 + |R_eff|); crossings = not-below -> below transitions (service_v30.reserve_crossing)
bounded_service_semantics.reuse: Gate 1D bounded service semantics verbatim (registered 10-step order; service <= available and <= demand; unmet = demand - service exactly; explicit non-negativity corrections; exact ledger closure with named losses; demand in the saturating service step, not the drive)
bounded_service_semantics.theorem_scope: the bounded wrapper remains OUTSIDE the V2.8 D0 theorem (O13); passing checks are numerical validation, never proof

heuristic.act_condition: execute e* only if Delta e_(e*)(q_(e*)*) > 0 strictly; otherwise rest (voluntary rest is recorded)
heuristic.boundary_optimality_lemma: registered analytic finding: with the source penalty-inactive at the frozen state and one destination deficit branch, the exact schedule is strictly increasing on the feasible menu for every r_dt <= 1 world here, so q_e* = q_e_max; an interior menu optimum observed in the study is therefore itself a reportable surprise, not noise
heuristic.continuous_diagnostic: the closed-form continuous vertex q_cont* of the piecewise-quadratic schedule is RECORDED per candidate as a diagnostic (menu-discretization gap); it never selects actions
heuristic.name: exact-total-quote greedy (candidate heuristic, NOT a theorem)
heuristic.per_edge_quantity: q_e* = argmax over the REGISTERED FINITE MENU {frac * J_e : frac in quantity_menu, capped at the authoritative P1C budget} of the exact committed schedule Delta e_e(q); exact enumeration, deterministic, never evaluated outside [0, q_e_max]
heuristic.q_zero_branch: q = 0 is the exact rest branch: schedule(0) = 0 with c0 = 0; rest settles nothing
heuristic.ranking_quantity: exact TOTAL quote Delta e_e(q). EBU per unit is FORBIDDEN as a ranking key (falsifier F8); per-unit values are recorded as diagnostics only
heuristic.settlement_form: exact finite-difference quote (foundation eq 6.1) via ebu_quote_v30.build_quote/exact; the linear diagnostic dt*q*(mu_i - eta*mu_j) - C(q) is NEVER used for settlement or ranking
heuristic.tie_rule: exact-quote ties break by (lower edge index, then lower quantity-menu index): deterministic identifiers only, no hidden physical objective

hypotheses.H1: observational quotes leave B and C byte-identical
hypotheses.H10: a multi-edge aggregate quote cannot be replaced by a naive sum of independently frozen edge quotes without proof (diagnostic: naive sum - group quote >= 0 on credit side, strictly > 0 whenever two accepted actions share the source and convexity is strict)
hypotheses.H2: at least one primary world makes the one-action restriction genuinely bind (O14_W4 by construction: sigma_A < 1 at both dts)
hypotheses.H3: A vs B quantifies a nonzero capability cost somewhere
hypotheses.H4: D preserves P1C reserves and produces no physical overuse
hypotheses.H5: exact-total-quote choice adapts when local destination conditions reverse (O14_W5 selected-edge series switches)
hypotheses.H6: quote per unit and exact total quote can rank candidates differently (checked over all recorded candidate pairs)
hypotheses.H7: in feasible worlds, D does not persistently under-serve relative to B under the registered predicate
hypotheses.H8: in infeasible worlds, P1C exposes scarcity through explicit unmet demand (O14_W6)

quantity_menu.cap: min(frac * J_e, authoritative per-source P1C budget); the menu NEVER exceeds q_e_max
quantity_menu.of: the D0 raw loss-aware flux J_e of the candidate edge
quantity_menu.provenance: registered fresh for this gate (the locked Gate-1 QUANTS=[0.5,1.0] is a Gate-1C/1D convention, not a law); four levels give the quantity-choice question a non-vacuous resolution and make the boundary-optimality lemma falsifiable

question: When one source has several simultaneously available outgoing choices, does maximizing the exact local total EBU quote select actions that preserve the source and provide useful service, or can it prefer a locally profitable but service-inferior destination or quantity?

request_shaping.arm_A: full world unmodified: all raw fluxes requested, sigma-scaled
request_shaping.identity: q_acc(executed) = min(frac * J_e, Q_max) = menu q_acc; asserted per tick in the future test suite
request_shaping.reason: Gate 1D executed the full flux of the selected edge regardless of the ranked fraction (requests are regenerated inside p1c_step); O14 requires the SELECTED quantity to be the EXECUTED quantity, otherwise quantity choice is cosmetic
request_shaping.rule: the selected candidate (edge e, fraction frac) is executed by presenting p1c_v29.p1c_step with an active world whose single edge is e with mobility M_sel = frac * M_e; the released allocator then generates the request frac * J_e itself and applies its own authoritative budget and sigma scaling; p1c_v29 is NOT modified

no threshold may change after outcome inspection

service_alignment_predicate.reuse: Gate 1D predicate VERBATIM (no mathematical contradiction was found): fires iff EBU > 1.0 AND (service deficit >= 5% relative AND >= 1.0 absolute on post-burn-in cumulatives with per-tick persistence over the final 20 ticks, OR the unmet-demand mirror) AND NOT preservation-justified (delta_R = 0.5 rule); tolerance 1e-9 * (1 + |value|)

world_conventions.defaults: cells: alpha=1.0, beta=0.5, chi=0.0, L=5.0, U=15.0, R=0.0, K=20.0; sources: logistic rho=0.6, chi=1.0, R=8.0 (= P1C R_eff) unless noted; edges: M=0.5, theta=0.05 unless noted

world_conventions.process_cost: C_a(q) = c0 + c1*q with c0 = 0.0, c1 = 0.1 * dt * (1 - eta) (lam_L = 0.1), category unrepresented_action_process_burden - the Gate-1 convention, unchanged

O14_W1_eta_split.discriminates: A vs B capability cost (second destination unserved under restriction); eta sensitivity of both rules
O14_W1_eta_split.note: identical destinations in equal deficit (D=3.0); edges differ only in eta (0.95 vs 0.60). Isolates transport-loss sensitivity; A-vs-B measures the cost of serving one destination instead of two. Analytic initial fluxes J=(2.825, 1.775), both > 0; B and D expected to agree (higher eta dominates force AND quote).

O14_W2_severity_split.discriminates: C3 destination choice under identical capability: B and D provably select different edges at t0
O14_W2_severity_split.family: severe small deficit vs mild large deficit
O14_W2_severity_split.note: dst1 severe-small (alpha=2, D=1.0); dst2 mild-large (alpha=0.3, D=6.0, request 2.5x via M=1.5). Analytic at x0, both registered dts: force ranks edge0 first (f=2.100 > 1.740) so B picks the severe-small deficit; the exact TOTAL quote ranks edge1 first (e.g. near dt +0.45554 > +0.22484) so D moves more material to the mild-large deficit. B != D at t0 at BOTH timesteps.

O14_W3_volume_split.discriminates: S vs B/D attribution; total-quote prefers less material for more EBU relative to the volume alternative
O14_W3_volume_split.note: dst1: deep low-weight deficit with high demand 2.0 (high volume, low burden weight alpha=0.1); dst2: steep small deficit, demand 0.25. Force AND total quote both prefer the low-volume high-severity dst2 (f=7.2 vs 2.16; quote e.g. near +1.94165 vs +0.73347); the service-priority arm S prefers the high-volume dst1. Separates quote-specific from restriction-generic service loss; also the registered example of MORE EBU from LESS material moved (chosen q=3.575 < alternative q=4.220 with ~2.6x the quote).

O14_W4_budget_bind.discriminates: H2/H3: nonzero A-vs-B capability cost; F4 cannot fire vacuously here
O14_W4_budget_bind.family: binding source budget, four competing destinations
O14_W4_budget_bind.note: source starts 0.6 above R_eff=8 so the aggregate robust budget binds in arm A at BOTH dts: sum J = 10.700 vs Q_max = 8.713 (cons, sigma=0.814) and 6.148 (near, sigma=0.575). Four identical destinations in deficit; total demand 2.4 < eta*g_max = 2.7 keeps the world feasible. The one-action restriction is structurally binding: A spreads the budget over 4 destinations, B/C/D/S reach one per micro-step.

O14_W5_reversal.discriminates: H5 adaptation: selected-edge series must switch; a frozen-choice policy cannot track the reversal
O14_W5_reversal.note: initially edge0 dominates for both rules (f=7.920 vs 6.480; quote e.g. near +7.65558 vs +6.23484). dst1 has low demand 0.1 so deliveries shrink its deficit D1 while dst2's demand 1.2 deepens D2; the local force boundary 3.6*D1 = 1.44*D2 and the corresponding total-quote boundary are crossed in finite time (analytic: D1 contracts at rate ~1.62*D1 per unit time while D2 grows at 1.2), so the preferred destination must switch using local data only.

O14_W6_infeasible.discriminates: H8/F6: preservation under scarcity with explicit unmet demand; multi-edge analogue of Gate 1D W2
O14_W6_infeasible.note: total essential demand 6.0 > eta*g_max = 0.9*3.0 = 2.7: no policy can serve it preservation-safely. P1C must ration; bounded service must expose explicit unmet demand, never phantom service; expected class physical_impossibility with zero material reserve crossings under the corrected scale-aware tolerance.
